title: The Tainted Cup
author: Robert Jackson Bennett
summary: In an empire protected by walls against giant sea beasts, a young investigator named Din is paired with Ana Dolabra, an odd but brilliant detective. A murder at a grand house, tied to the monsters' biology, pulls them into a bigger plot.
readIf: you like fantasy mysteries with a Holmes-and-Watson dynamic and strange, inventive worldbuilding.
skipIf: you want a fast-paced action story, since the case is built on slow deductions and detail.

pairings.reason: The original detective and companion pair this book openly takes inspiration from, in a very different world.
A fine, scholarly murder mystery set in a closed community with a brilliant investigator and his young aide.
Same author, with equally inventive magic and a thief heroine, and more of a heist adventure.
